modules.title: Introduction to Data Security and Ethics
modules.html:
Computer viruses, passwords, cybercrime and copyright. This section covers introduction to data security and ethics.

Key points

  • Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing data packets — Network Layer.
  • What is the maximum data capacity of a standard CD-ROM — 700 MB.
  • In computer ethics, 'Copyright' is intended to _____. — Protect original works of authorship.
  • Data processed becomes: — Information.
  • Smallest unit of data: — Bit.

Worked examples

Q: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing data packets?
A: Network Layer — The Network Layer handles the addressing and routing of data packets across different networks.

Q: What is the maximum data capacity of a standard CD-ROM?
A: 700 MB — A standard Compact Disc (CD) typically holds 700 MB of data. 4.7 GB is the standard for a DVD.

quiz.q: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing data packets?
quiz.solution: The Network Layer handles the addressing and routing of data packets across different networks.

quiz.q: What is the maximum data capacity of a standard CD-ROM?
quiz.solution: A standard Compact Disc (CD) typically holds 700 MB of data. 4.7 GB is the standard for a DVD.

quiz.q: In computer ethics, 'Copyright' is intended to _____.
quiz.solution: Copyright laws provide legal protection to the creators of intellectual property.

quiz.q: Data processed becomes:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Information.

quiz.q: Smallest unit of data:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Bit.

quiz.q: Which database model organizes data into tables with rows and columns?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Relational.

quiz.q: A pixel is _____.
options: The smallest unit of a digital image
quiz.solution: Pixels are the small dots that make up the images on computer displays.

quiz.q: The physical path over which a message travels is called the _____.
quiz.solution: The transmission medium (e.g., fiber optic cable, wireless) is the physical link between sender and receiver.

quiz.q: Which of the following is an example of an impact printer?
quiz.solution: Impact printers (like Dot Matrix) function by striking an inked ribbon against the paper.

quiz.q: Which generation of computers used Vacuum Tubes?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: First.

quiz.q: The intersection of a row and column in Excel is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Cell.

quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Start/Stop.

quiz.q: Byte is:

quiz.q: Cold Booting is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Turning on from off.

quiz.q: Which symbol is used to start a formula in Microsoft Excel?
